We need to call search_template_catalog_by_criteria with molecule_smiles set to the product SMILES. Let's extract product SMILES from list: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO". That's the product (alkene with carboxylic acid). Use that.

We will search with functional_groups_formed: ["aliphatic carboxylic acid", "C-C double bonds"].

We can also include functional_groups_broken maybe "phosphonate"? Not in list. So just formed.

Let's call search_template_catalog_by_criteria with molecule_smiles set to that SMILES, functional_groups_formed list, limit 5.
